description: Fuzzy-search markers by alias across EN/RU/HE. Useful when the upstream LLM has the lab's local name (e.g. "гликированный гемоглобин", "המוגלובין מסוכרר", "A1C") and needs to find the canonical Mediora slug.

lang.description: Preferred language for returned names. Defaults to 'en'.

query.description: Free-text marker name in EN/RU/HE; e.g. 'A1C', 'гликированный', 'TSH', 'ויטמין D'.

name: mediora__lookup_marker
title: Find a marker by name
